title: Alphabet annual capital expenditure
definition: Purchases of property and equipment (capital expenditure) reported on Alphabet Inc.'s Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, primarily reflecting investments in technical infrastructure including servers and data centers.

sources.title: Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1: Alphabet Announces Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2025 Results

points.evidence: Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, 'Purchases of property and equipment', Year Ended December 31, 2024: $52,535 million.
Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, 'Purchases of property and equipment', Year Ended December 31, 2025: $91,447 million.
